description: This file contains implementations of inverse trigonometric functions (asin, acos, atan) for rational number representations, including Taylor series approximations and angle conversions, as well as functions to handle different angle units (radians, degrees, gradians).

methods.name: ascalerat
methods.description: Converts the angle in PRAT form to the specified angle type (radians, degrees, gradians) by scaling the rational value accordingly.

methods.name: _asinrat
methods.description: Computes the arcsine of a rational number using Taylor series approximation.

methods.name: asinrat
methods.description: Calculates the inverse sine of a rational number, handling domain restrictions and special cases.

methods.name: asinanglerat
methods.description: Calculates the inverse sine of a rational number and converts the result to the specified angle type.

methods.name: _acosrat
methods.description: Computes the arccosine of a rational number using Taylor series approximation.

methods.name: acosrat
methods.description: Calculates the inverse cosine of a rational number, handling special cases.

methods.name: acosanglerat
methods.description: Calculates the inverse cosine of a rational number and converts the result to the specified angle type.

methods.name: _atanrat
methods.description: Computes the arctangent of a rational number using Taylor series approximation.

methods.name: atanrat
methods.description: Calculates the inverse tangent of a rational number, handling large values and domain restrictions.

methods.name: atananglerat
methods.description: Calculates the inverse tangent of a rational number and converts the result to the specified angle type.
